phases.name: Slice-01: every beach says why to trust its own number
phases.description: Carriage and composition, not scoring. The engine already computes dominant, spread_terms, missing and track_state per row, and the build throws them away. This slice composes one true Spanish sentence per spot per day and carries it to the screen. No cap or boundary moves.

steps.name: Reason composed, names the binding cap, rides both halves
criteria: Engine result additively carries the missing inputs and the member count; no cap, boundary or spread constant changes.
A pure composer builds one Spanish sentence from dominant, missing and member count, never from the level word.
The tide-dark morning's sentence names the missing tide and blames no model disagreement that did not happen.
Both bundle halves carry the reason: day summary as an object, reading surface beside call_es; conf_value never travels.
Every composed sentence stays at or under 160 characters, with no code text and no em dash.
steps.scenario_name: La razón nombra la marea que falta, porque es la que topó el nivel
steps.non_visual_rationale: Producer-side composition and wire carriage: the sentence is composed and placed on the bundle, but nothing this lane may edit mounts it on a page, so there is no rendered state to observe here. The rendered surface is charter-gated at 01-11.
steps.implementation_notes: TEST PARADIGM (mandatory, adapted): the composer is a pure function and its unit tests are property-based with fast-check, house style tests/unit/scoring-laws.test.ts; example-based tests are fallback only with a documented reason; integration and E2E stay single-example. Adapted from the Hypothesis wording because this repo is TypeScript with fast-check. DISPATCH: project CLAUDE.md selects @nw-functional-software-crafter for every DELIVER step; the agent field uses the schema-valid name and the orchestrator maps it. THE DEFECT THIS SLICE FIXES, verified on disk: confidenceReasonEs(level) in src/scoring/confidence.ts line 107 measures 204 / 205 / 209 characters against P1's 160 bound, and the bound has never fired because the string never travels: build.ts line 209 keeps only c_total and level, and daySummary() and surfaceCall() drop the rest, so grep -c confidence_reason data/published-surface.json returns 0. Worse, it misattributes: every live row is capped by missing tide (dominant 'missing_data') yet low rows read 'Los modelos no se ponen de acuerdo'. The models agree fine; there is no tide station. COMPOSE FROM dominant, missing, members_used, track_state and c_fresh. NEVER from level. IN-LANE WORK. (a) src/scoring/confidence.ts: ConfidenceResult additively gains `missing: ('wind'|'tide')[]` and `members_used: number` (members.length), both already available inside confidence(); this is a pure return-shape addition, it changes no arithmetic, and it keeps the required build.ts diff to carriage only. Do NOT delete or reword confidenceReasonEs: src/components/Confidence.astro line 41 imports it and that file is outside this lane's boundary; it becomes dead the day the mount swaps, and its removal is recorded debt for whoever owns the mount. (b) NEW src/publish/confidence-reason.ts exporting composeConfidenceReasonEs(result, vocab) -> string. Direction publish -> scoring is the correct one; build.ts already imports region-bundle types from src/publish, so the call site compiles. (c) src/publish/region-bundle.ts: BundleDaySummary gains `readonly confidence_reason?: { readonly es: string }` (optional: P1's degrade is the details block omitted). (d) src/publish/static-surface.ts: SurfaceCall gains `readonly confidence_reason_es?: string` beside call_es; leave isSurfaceCall() alone, the field is optional exactly like conf_level. FIELD NAMES ARE FIXED by distill/red-classification.md 'Contracts this slice fixes': day summary carries confidence_reason: { es }, reading surface carries confidence_reason_es, and one of the two must appear on BOTH halves. es-only is a recorded deviation from P1's {es,en}; F-READ-IT-IN-YOUR-LANGUAGE owns the other half. VOCABULARY, SEQUENCED, DO NOT AUTHOR A SECOND COPY: composeConfidenceReasonEs takes the Spanish factor vocabulary as a PARAMETER (Readonly<Record<'height'|'period'|'direction'|'wind'|'tide', string>> -> altura, período, dirección, viento, marea). Unit tests pass a local literal, so this step is unblocked today. f-see-what-killed-it is authoring src/publish/factor-vocab.ts RIGHT NOW, import-free so it can move later; its R28 and this feature's R12 are the same obligation. The production call site supplies THEIR module, as part of the recorded build.ts diff below. src/data/report-vocab.ts carries wind and quality only and is a forbidden lane file. CROSS-LANE DIFF A, SERIALIZED, DO NOT EDIT src/pipeline/build.ts IN THIS LANE. The carriage CANNOT legally avoid build.ts and this is settled, not a preference: DoD 2 forbids conf_value and the raw factor terms from entering the bundle, so the sentence must be composed where the engine result still exists, and that is the confidence(...) call site; daySummary() and surfaceCall() are local functions of build.ts with no seam in src/publish/ to intercept. Exact required diff, line numbers against this worktree's build.ts: (1) import composeConfidenceReasonEs from '../publish/confidence-reason' and the vocabulary from '../publish/factor-vocab'; (2) type CallRow, after line 94 `conf_level: ConfLevel;`, add `confidence_reason_es: string;`; (3) after line 209 `const confidenceResult = confidence(members, { kind: 'absolute' }, null, null, score.missing);` add `const confidence_reason_es = composeConfidenceReasonEs(confidenceResult, FACTOR_VOCAB_ES);`; (4) in the returned row literal, after line 219 `conf_level: confidenceResult.level,`, add `confidence_reason_es,`; (5) in daySummary(), after line 245 `conf_level: call.conf_level,`, add `confidence_reason: { es: call.confidence_reason_es },`; (6) in surfaceCall(), after line 260 `conf_level: call.conf_level,`, add `confidence_reason_es: call.confidence_reason_es,`. Pre-requisite 3 also owes the producer guard a confidence_reason row (missing = details omitted per P1; conf_level missing = FAIL), which belongs with that lane beside the five-field guard from HANDOFF section 10.

steps.name: Same sentence admits nobody reported, no verified record
criteria: The same tide-dark sentence says nobody has reported from the beach and that this spot has no verified record.
Both clauses render from track_state and c_fresh inputs, never hardcoded, so the copy flips when real inputs arrive.
No composed reason claims or implies that anyone confirmed conditions from the beach.
The four-clause sentence still fits 160 characters; a shape that cannot fit fails the property test loudly.
steps.scenario_name: La razón admite que nadie ha reportado y que no hay historial verificado
steps.non_visual_rationale: Two more clauses on the same producer-side sentence, asserted against composed output before it reaches any page; the rendered surface is charter-gated at 01-11.
steps.implementation_notes: TEST PARADIGM (mandatory, adapted): property-based with fast-check as in 01-01. SAME SENTENCE, NOT A SECOND ONE. Scenarios 1, 2 and 3 share one Given (una mañana sin dato de marea, con los modelos pareciéndose entre ellos), so all three inspect THE SAME composed string and their oracles are a union: it must name the missing tide (05 section 3.6), say nobody has reported (05 section 6.3), say there is no verified record (05 section 6.2), stay at or under 160 characters (P1), claim no model disagreement, leak no code text and carry no em dash. This step adds the two binding copy clauses to the sentence 01-01 started; scenario 1 must stay green. INPUT-DRIVEN, NEVER HARDCODED (DoD 4): the nobody-has-reported clause is emitted because c_fresh is null (no report ever, excluded from the product per 05 section 6.3), and the no-verified-record clause because track_state is 'unverified'. When real reports and a gated scorecard arrive, those inputs change and the sentence must change itself with no code edit. A composer that emits either clause unconditionally passes today's oracles and lies the day the inputs flip, which is exactly what DoD 4 forbids; the property test must exercise the measured branch (track_state 'measured', c_fresh non-null) and assert the clauses disappear. WORDING IS NOT SETTLED, AND THAT IS FINE: Pre-requisite 1 is open and Andres owns the phrasing through the cousin's crew channel. No acceptance oracle pins wording word for word; each requires only the domain noun any settled phrasing must contain, singular or plural: marea(s), período(s), historial(es), and nadie plus playa. DISTILL already verified the union is satisfiable at 138 of 160 characters with 22 characters of headroom, so feasibility is closed and only wording is owed. Hold every phrase in ONE exported constant table next to the composer so sign-off is a one-line swap, and do not invent flowery product copy. LENGTH IS AN ENFORCED PROMISE, NOT A HOPE: the property test asserts at or under 160 characters across every generated shape, so an over-budget wording fails at unit level rather than silently truncating; truncation is forbidden outright because 01-07's fidelity oracle requires the rendered string to add and trim nothing. The tightest shape is single-model plus missing tide plus both honesty clauses (01-05); budget the clause wording against that worst case, not against the tide-dark case alone.

steps.name: No alta, and no constant may move
criteria: A unit guard pins cap_missing_tide, the wind cap and both level boundaries bit-identical to 82be859's confidence.ts.
The guard fails if any constant moves, so alta cannot be reached by lowering a bar.
With tide dark and four agreeing members the level stays media and the reason names the missing tide.
steps.scenario_name: Sin el dato de la marea nadie ve confianza alta, y la razón dice por qué
steps.non_visual_rationale: A constants guard and a composed-sentence assertion; its whole observable is a unit test that must fail when a constant moves. No pixels exist to judge.
steps.implementation_notes: TEST PARADIGM (mandatory, adapted): the guard is example-based by nature (it pins exact literals) and that is its documented bypass reason; the accompanying level-projection assertion is property-based with fast-check. THE HARD CONSTRAINT OF THIS WHOLE SLICE, from the dispatch and from distill/red-classification.md contract item 4: alta is arithmetically unreachable today and NO step may fix anything by moving a cap or a boundary. Measured on disk: cap_missing_tide = 0.7 (confidence.ts line 52) binds whenever missing contains 'tide'; level = high requires c_total > 0.7 (line 55), so the cap lands EXACTLY on the boundary; four genuinely agreeing members with tide dark measure c_spread 0.9922 and c_total 0.7000 exactly, level medium; the live published surface is 56 low, 4 medium, 0 high across 60 rows. The same members with tide present measure c_total 0.9922 and level high, which is slice-02's job via a real tide_m, never a constant change. WHY THIS STEP EXISTS AT ALL: scenario 3's first oracle (ninguna playa se publica con confianza alta) PASSES today and is a standing guard; its second oracle is the RED and 01-01 closes it. So this step's deliverable is not the sentence, it is the ENFORCEMENT that keeps the guard armed: a unit guard pinning cap_missing_tide 0.7, cap_missing_wind 0.4, the 0.4 low boundary and the 0.7 medium boundary bit-identical to 82be859's confidence.ts (DoD 5), so that a future well-meaning edit that reaches alta by lowering a bar fails at unit level in seconds instead of at acceptance in minutes. PROVE IT FALSIFIABLE (project CLAUDE.md, two tests in this repo have already passed for accidental reasons): change cap_missing_tide to 0.8, watch this guard fail for the right reason AND watch scenario 3's first oracle go red, revert, verify the revert with git diff. Record both observations in the step evidence.

steps.name: Period disagreement named, tide never blamed when present
criteria: With tide present and dominant spread_period, the sentence names the period disagreement in surfer words.
That sentence never mentions the tide, because nothing about the tide bound the level.
Factor nouns come from the shared Spanish vocabulary passed in, never from a second copy authored here.
steps.scenario_name: Cuando el que manda es el desacuerdo de período, la razón lo dice y no culpa a la marea
steps.non_visual_rationale: A second producer-side sentence shape asserted against composed output; no page renders it until the cross-lane mounts land, and 01-11 carries the charter for what renders.
steps.implementation_notes: TEST PARADIGM (mandatory, adapted): property-based with fast-check as in 01-01. THIS IS THE MISATTRIBUTION FIX, SEEN FROM THE OTHER SIDE. 01-01 stopped the composer blaming models when the tide capped the level; this step stops it blaming the tide when the tide is fine. The morning is the real 2026-08-08 Venao pull with tide present: missing is empty, dominant is spread_period, and the sentence must name the period disagreement and must NOT contain marea. That asymmetry is what makes the composer honest in both directions, and it is why the composer reads dominant and missing rather than level. THE CAUSE HIERARCHY, which every shape shares: a single-model day (members_used < 2, step 01-05) names that first; then any missing input names itself, one clause per missing input, because a cap that binds is the thing that topped the level (05 section 3.6's cap-application row); only when nothing is missing does the dominant spread term speak. Note that confidence() sets dominant to 'missing_data' whenever missing is non-empty, so the spread branch is only reachable with missing empty, which the type system and the property test should both make obvious. VOCABULARY: 'período' comes from the injected vocabulary parameter, which the sibling lane's src/publish/factor-vocab.ts will supply in production. DELIVER owes ONE module, not two copies (distill/red-classification.md, and f-see-what-killed-it's R28). If that module has landed on the integration branch by the time this step runs, import it; if not, keep the parameter and let the recorded build.ts diff wire it. Under no circumstance author a second vocabulary in this lane. SURFER WORDS, NOT MODEL WORDS: zero technical text on the Spanish surface (project CLAUDE.md), so no model names, no field names, no 'spread', no percentages of a term. 05 section 6's illustrative '72% of the penalty comes from the period disagreement' is engine documentation, not shipping copy; the surface says the swell period is what the models cannot agree on, in the register a surfer uses.

steps.name: One answering model reads as one model
criteria: When members_used is one, the sentence says a single model answered.
That sentence never blames the models for a disagreement that did not happen.
The single-model clause coexists with a missing-input clause and both still fit 160 characters.
steps.scenario_name: Un día en que solo respondió un modelo lo dice así, nunca como desacuerdo
steps.non_visual_rationale: The third producer-side sentence shape, asserted against composed output from a three-sources-dark morning; nothing renders it in this lane.
steps.implementation_notes: TEST PARADIGM (mandatory, adapted): property-based with fast-check; the members_used branch is a quantified invariant over member counts, not three examples. THE SHAPE: three of four declared sources dark, members_used = 1. The engine already handles the arithmetic honestly (absoluteSpreadTerms returns zeros below two members and absoluteSpread caps the value at 0.4, the 05 section 6.1 f(M) cap), so this step adds no scoring behaviour; it makes the SENTENCE tell the truth about why. A one-member day has no disagreement to report, and a composer that fell through to a spread term would invent one. WHY members_used AND NOT dominant: with one member the spread terms are all zero, so dominant carries no signal at all, and if anything is also missing dominant reads 'missing_data'. The member count is the only input that distinguishes 'nobody disagreed because only one model spoke' from 'the models agree'. That is why 01-01 puts members_used on the result. THE TIGHTEST BUDGET IN THE SLICE, and the reason this step also owns a length property: this shape can carry the single-model clause, a missing-tide clause and both honesty clauses at once. Illustrative arithmetic only, wording is Pre-requisite 1's and Andres's: a naive composition of the four clauses at the DISTILL-verified phrasing overruns 160, and a compact phrasing of the same four clauses lands near 140. So the clause wording must be budgeted against THIS worst case. The property test must generate the combined shape and assert the bound; it fails loudly rather than truncating, because 01-07's fidelity oracle forbids the renderer from trimming anything. If a settled wording cannot fit this shape, that is a copy escalation to Andres through the cousin's crew channel, never a loosened oracle and never a truncation.

steps.name: Disclosure renders the row's own published reason
criteria: A new disclosure component takes the level word and an optional per-row reason as props.
It renders details.confidence with the level word in summary and the reason as the single non-summary child.
Two rows with different published reasons render different text; nothing derives a reason from the level.
steps.scenario_name: El surfista abre <lista> y lee la razón de su playa para ese día
steps.non_visual_rationale: This step creates a component and nothing in this lane's file boundary may mount it: RankedList.astro and SpotDetail.astro are another lane's. Marking it user-visible would fail all seven UI checks by construction, because no built page renders it yet. The visible gate sits at 01-11, after the recorded cross-lane mounts land.
steps.implementation_notes: EXEMPT FROM PARADIGM: a single zero-JS presentational component with two props; compensated by the property-based composer tests in 01-01 through 01-05 and by the acceptance fidelity oracle in 01-07. SCENARIO COVERAGE: this step owns the Scenario Outline 'El surfista abre <lista> y lee la razón de su playa para ese día', which expands to TWO executed scenarios, 'El surfista abre la lista de hoy y lee la razón de su playa para ese día' and 'El surfista abre la lista de mañana y lee la razón de su playa para ese día'. Both walk the same component over the same published shape; the day index differs, the code path does not. WHY A NEW FILE AND NOT AN EDIT: src/components/Confidence.astro derives the reason from level alone (line 49) so no caller can pass a per-row one, and that file is outside this lane's boundary. ConfidenceDetail.astro is the new component this lane owns. Props: level: ConfidenceLevel (required) and reason?: string (optional, absent means the degrade path of 01-08). MARKUP IS FIXED by distill/red-classification.md 'Contracts this slice fixes': details.confidence, the level word inside <summary> as the full phrase 'Confianza alta/media/baja' (the product decision recorded in Confidence.astro's header, a bare level word reads as small waves), and the reason in the SINGLE non-summary child. Keep name="confidence" so the disclosures stay a native exclusive group with zero JavaScript (adr-publish-time-html-rendering.md). Keep data-level for the level. No aria-label: the visible text already says the full phrase and summary's native semantics announce the state. THE ORACLE THAT MATTERS: the acceptance steps read innerText, never textContent, deliberately. A component that emits the reason and never renders it visibly would satisfy textContent and be caught here as an empty box. Do not hide the reason behind display:none, visibility:hidden or a zero-sized box for any state other than the browser's own collapsed <details>. CROSS-LANE DIFF C, SERIALIZED, DO NOT EDIT src/components/RankedList.astro IN THIS LANE. Exact required diff: line 8 `import Confidence from './Confidence.astro';` becomes `import ConfidenceDetail from './ConfidenceDetail.astro';`, and line 89 `{summary.conf_level !== undefined && <Confidence level={summary.conf_level} />}` becomes `{summary.conf_level !== undefined && <ConfidenceDetail level={summary.conf_level} reason={summary.confidence_reason?.es} />}`. CROSS-LANE DIFF B, ALSO REQUIRED AND NOT NAMED IN THE DISPATCH, FLAGGED: src/data/forecast.ts is a forbidden lane file (src/data/**) and it is a whitelist. summaries() at lines 60-71 copies fields one by one, so a confidence_reason_es added to SurfaceCall is SILENTLY DROPPED there and never reaches either page. Exact required diff: interface DaySummary, after line 45 `readonly conf_level?: ConfLevel;`, add `readonly confidence_reason?: { readonly es: string };`; and in summaries(), after line 69, add `...(call.confidence_reason_es === undefined ? {} : { confidence_reason: { es: call.confidence_reason_es } }),`. Without this diff the reading half of the slice cannot go green no matter what this lane builds. REJECTED ALTERNATIVE, recorded so nobody re-derives it: having ConfidenceDetail.astro read data/published-surface.json itself would avoid src/data/forecast.ts, but it creates a second reader of the published surface, breaks the 'pages never compute' rule the display-format layer rests on, and opens a leak path into the forecast-free report route (leak path L1). The props-based design plus one whitelist line is the honest shape. ORDERING OF THE CROSS-LANE DIFFS IS LOAD-BEARING, NOT A PREFERENCE: diff A must land AND a real pipeline run must repopulate the committed data/published-surface.json with confidence_reason_es BEFORE diffs B and C are applied. ConfidenceDetail renders NO reason block when reason is undefined (that is 01-08's degrade path), while the Confidence.astro it replaces always renders one, so swapping the mount early strips the disclosure the ranked rows ship today: a silent user-visible regression introduced by a one-line wiring edit. The acceptance suite will NOT catch it, because the reading half plants its own values into a temp copy of the project and never reads the committed surface. This is the same shape as the conf_level bug that passed all ten CI jobs. The integrator applies A, runs the pipeline, verifies grep -c confidence_reason data/published-surface.json is non-zero, and only then applies B, C and D.

steps.name: Shown reason is exactly the published one
criteria: The component renders the published string verbatim: nothing added, nothing trimmed, no truncation anywhere.
The existing beach-claim and raw-data guards extend to per-spot reasons, not only the level-keyed one.
No rendered reason carries technical text, English or an em dash.
No rendered reason exceeds 160 characters, which holds because the composer's bound holds.
steps.scenario_name: La razón que se muestra es exactamente la publicada y cabe en el bolsillo
steps.non_visual_rationale: Text fidelity and copy-guard coverage, asserted string against string; the measured-pixel judgement of the same block is 01-11's, which carries the charter and the seven checks.
steps.implementation_notes: TEST PARADIGM (mandatory, adapted): the extended copy guards are property-based with fast-check over every composable shape, which is the point: the shipped guards in tests/unit/confidence-reason-copy.test.ts (CLAIMS_BEACH_CONFIRMATION, LEAKS_RAW_DATA) today cover exactly three level-keyed strings, and after this slice the reason space is per spot and per day. DoD 10 requires those guards to cover the per-spot reasons. Extend them to run over the composer's output across generated engine states rather than over three constants. FIDELITY IS THE WHOLE STEP: the page must show THIS row's published reason, byte for byte. No truncation, no ellipsis, no CSS line-clamp that would make innerText differ from the published string, no capitalisation fix-up, no trailing-period normalisation. If the string is too long for the box, that is a layout problem for 01-11 to solve with wrapping, never a text problem to solve by cutting. The 160-character bound is the composer's promise (01-02, 01-05); this step asserts the renderer does not break it, so if the acceptance oracle ever reports a rendered length over 160 the defect is upstream in the composer, not here. THE LIVE DEFECT THIS ORACLE CATCHES TODAY: the shipped confidenceReasonEs measures 204 / 205 / 209 characters, which is what the RED run reported as 'la fila 1 (playa-guanico) muestra 204 caracteres'. NO TECHNICAL TEXT, NO EM DASH (project CLAUDE.md copy rules): no model names, no JSON, no placeholder tokens, no English, no raw timestamps, and no em dash anywhere in any UI string. The guard belongs in the unit tests so it fails in seconds, not only in the acceptance suite.

steps.name: A reasonless row shows its level and stays quiet
criteria: A row published without a reason renders no reason block at all, never an empty one.
That row still shows its confidence word, so the level never disappears with the reason.
The degrade is P1's: the details reason is omitted, while a missing conf_level stays a failure.
steps.scenario_name: Una playa publicada sin razón muestra su nivel y calla, mientras la de al lado sí la trae
steps.non_visual_rationale: A degrade branch in the same unmounted component; its observable is the absence of a block, which the acceptance oracle reads over the built page once the cross-lane mounts land. 01-11 carries the charter.
steps.implementation_notes: EXEMPT FROM PARADIGM: one designed degrade state on a two-prop component; compensated by the composer's property tests. THE CONTRACT, from application-architecture section 7 P1 and DoD 2: when the reason is absent the degrade is THE DETAILS REASON OMITTED, never an empty or raw one. Render no non-summary child at all. Do not render an empty <div>, a placeholder, a dash, a 'sin razón' string or any invented text. The confidence word still renders, because conf_level missing is a FAIL condition and the level is what P1 requires on every row. Concretely: when reason is undefined the component should emit the level word without a disclosure body, and the acceptance oracle 'no ofrece nada que abrir' must be satisfiable by structure, not by an invisible empty child. THE ANTI-VACUITY DESIGN, from distill/red-classification.md guard 2: this scenario asserts an ABSENCE, which is trivially true against a page that renders nothing at all, so the RED closes on the neighbouring beaches of the SAME published morning, which must open THEIR published reason. The fixture plants punta-brava with no reason and its neighbours with reasons. So a component that rendered no disclosure for anybody would fail the second oracle, and one that rendered an empty box for punta-brava would fail the first. Both halves must hold at once, which is exactly the honesty this product rests on: a missing value is a stated absence, never the most favourable reading, and never a silent empty box.

steps.name: Spot page day sections carry level and reason
criteria: The component renders correctly inside a day section as well as inside a ranked row.
Each day section shows its own day's confidence word and opens its own day's published reason.
Tomorrow's values are tomorrow's own, never today's copied forward.
steps.scenario_name: La página de la playa trae su nivel y su razón, hoy y mañana
steps.non_visual_rationale: The in-lane artifact is the component's day-section variant; the mount that makes it appear on the spot page is SpotDetail.astro, a forbidden lane file, so no built page renders this step's output inside this lane. The rendered spot page is charter-gated at 01-11.
steps.implementation_notes:
EXEMPT FROM PARADIGM: component composition inside a second layout context; compensated by the composer property tests and by the acceptance oracle over both section[data-day] blocks. THE GAP THIS CLOSES: SpotDetail.astro renders NO confidence at all today, in either day section (verified by grep: zero matches), against charter line 17 'home rows, tomorrow's rows, spot pages'. This is Baseline gap 4. WHAT THIS LANE CAN DO: make ConfidenceDetail.astro correct inside a section[data-day] block, which mostly means it must not assume the ranked row's grid context. Confidence.astro carries a row-specific layout decision (grid-column: 1 / -1, its own third grid row, authorised because 'Confianza baja' cost about 121px of a 314px column budget); ConfidenceDetail.astro must not inherit that assumption into a context with no grid, so scope any row-specific placement to the row and let the day-section case flow normally. CROSS-LANE DIFF D, SERIALIZED, DO NOT EDIT src/components/SpotDetail.astro IN THIS LANE. Exact required insertions, line numbers against this worktree's SpotDetail.astro: after line 18 `import { formatBestWindowEs, formatSizeEs } from '../publish/display-format';` add `import ConfidenceDetail from './ConfidenceDetail.astro';`; inside section[data-day="today"], immediately after line 72 `

{windowText(today)}

`, add `{today.conf_level !== undefined && }`; inside section[data-day="tomorrow"], immediately after line 86 `

{windowText(tomorrow)}

`, add the same line with tomorrow in place of today. Both insertions sit inside the existing truthy fragment, so the no-data branch at lines 74-76 and 88-90 is untouched. PRE-REQUISITE 4 IS STILL UNRESOLVED AND THE INTEGRATOR MUST SETTLE IT BEFORE THIS LANDS: Confidence.astro's own header says slice-06's spot page reuses it, and keystone slices 06 to 08 are building in other lanes. If the keystone lands a confidence mount on SpotDetail first, this slice only upgrades the reason and the mount diff above is not applied. NEVER BOTH. PER DAY, NOT COPIED: BundleDaySummary's own comment states every value is that day's own because confidence genuinely drops with lead time. The reason is per (spot_id, day), so tomorrow's section must read tomorrow's DaySummary, and the acceptance oracle walks both sections.

steps.name: Level reads by shape and word, never colour
criteria: Each level carries a non-colour shape indicator beside its word, per the design system's confidence recipe.
No computed colour distinguishes one confidence level from another.
The trigger's own text carries the full phrase, so the shape adds to the word and never replaces it.
steps.scenario_name: Quien no distingue colores lee la confianza igual, por forma y palabra
steps.non_visual_rationale: Markup and design-token work whose oracle is a computed-style comparison across levels plus the trigger's own text, both asserted by the acceptance scenario rather than judged by eye. The seven measured visual checks and the human charter are 01-11's.
steps.implementation_notes: EXEMPT FROM PARADIGM: a designed accessibility affordance on one component; the acceptance scenario is its oracle. THE RED HALF AND THE GUARD HALF: scenario 11's first oracle (ningún color distingue un nivel de confianza de otro) PASSES today and is a standing guard; the RED is 'la fila 1 no lleva la forma del nivel junto a la palabra: "Confianza baja"'. So this step must add the shape WITHOUT introducing colour as a level carrier. Adding a red/amber/green treatment to make the levels scannable would turn the passing guard red, and it would also fail WCAG's use-of-colour criterion. SHAPE COMES FROM 09-design-system.md section 9's confidence-indicator recipe (glyph dots beside the level word); read that section before inventing anything. Whatever glyph is used must be part of the accessible name or adjacent to visible text, must not be announced as a separate meaningless character to a screen reader, and must survive the dark theme unchanged in meaning. SCOPE FLAG, recorded by DISTILL, decide before building: R39's shape half comes from the design system's recipe and from the dispatch brief asking for shape-plus-word explicitly, not from the feature's own baseline gap table. If the integrator judges the shape half outside slice-01, strike it and scenario 11's second oracle; the colour guard stays either way. Do not silently drop it: escalate, then record the decision here.

steps.name: Confidence reads clean on the phone, both themes

steps.implementation_notes: DATA-GATED AND THRESHOLD-BLOCKED, RECORDED, DO NOT PLAN AROUND IT: the PublishedCall log began accumulating 2026-08-08, zero real spots have meaningful history, and the activation threshold (how many days of a spot's own spread history before the percentile form activates) is a number NOBODY HAS SET: Pre-requisite 7, open, owned by the DESIGN/learning lane plus Andres. This slice may sit pending for weeks and that is correct; shipping it early would compare a day against a history that does not exist, the exact dishonesty this product refuses. The acceptance history is accumulated HONESTLY: the scenarios publish 60 real mornings through the same driving ports production uses, so the history under test is the log the pipeline itself wrote, never a planted table; 60 sits above any sane threshold and 2 below, and if the settled number falls outside that range the fixture constant moves, never the oracle. THE THRESHOLD IS POLICY DATA, not code (05 section 6.1: 'switching forms is a data availability change'), so it belongs beside slice-03's confidence_factors in the launch policy. ENGINE ALREADY CARRIES THE ARM: SpreadInput's climatology variant exists in confidence.ts; the missing production behaviour is the build computing the spot's own spread percentile from the log and passing it. The log may need a per-row spread value to make the history computable; that is an additive, insert-only, forward-only schema addition, NEVER a backfill. src/pipeline/build.ts is producer-lane contended (Pre-requisite 3), serialized. Qualitative tails only: pct <= 20 maps to 1.0, mid to 0.7, >= 80 to 0.35, as data.

steps.name: Thin history keeps the absolute form and wording
criteria: Spots below the activation threshold keep the absolute CVs and never compare against a normal they do not have.
steps.scenario_name: Un spot recién llegado al registro no se compara contra un historial que no tiene
steps.non_visual_rationale: The below-threshold branch of the same form switch, producer-side.
steps.implementation_notes: The honesty gate against premature activation, and it PASSES today (recorded run reaches the deeper oracles only through the carriage gap): a two-morning spot keeps the absolute form and its dominant-term wording. It stands guard against the tempting shortcut of activating climatology whenever ANY history rows exist: a percentile computed over two mornings is noise wearing a costume. Also pins the per-spot grain: the threshold is evaluated per spot, so one history-rich spot activating never drags its thin-history neighbours with it. Copy-risk note, recorded: the below-threshold wording must avoid the word 'normal' (the oracle forbids it there), which constrains Pre-requisite 1's settled phrasings.

steps.name: Qualitative tails only, never a displayed percentile
criteria: No percentage, percentile or probability wording in any published reason, in either form, ever.
steps.scenario_name: La razón nunca muestra un porcentaje ni suena a probabilidad
steps.non_visual_rationale: A copy guard over the composed output, producer-side.
steps.implementation_notes: The out-of-scope table's 'Never' row made executable: calibrated error bars, displayed percentiles and probability wording of any kind are refused forever (research 09 section 3.6 qualitative-flag consequence; epic contradiction C4, closed). The percentile is an INPUT to the qualitative mapping, never a surface value: the moment the composer knows pct it will be tempting to write 'percentil 85' or 'un 85% peor', and this guard is what makes that a red build instead of a code review argument. Extend the unit-level copy guards (confidence-reason-copy.test.ts) with the same forbidden patterns across generated climatology states so it fails in seconds, not only at acceptance.

steps.name: Missing inputs outrank the climatology comparison
criteria: The cause hierarchy holds in the new form: a binding cap names its missing input first, and no normal-comparison rides a capped row.
steps.scenario_name: La ausencia de la marea manda aunque el historial exista
steps.non_visual_rationale: Composer cause-hierarchy under the climatology form, producer-side.
steps.implementation_notes: Same hierarchy slice-01 established (single-model first, then missing inputs, spread only when nothing is missing), now proven to survive the form switch: a history-rich spot whose tide went dark names the tide, and the normal-comparison stays out of that sentence entirely, because a day scored under a cap is not comparable against normals computed from uncapped mornings. Passes today for the accidental reason that no climatology exists; goes genuinely load-bearing at GREEN of 05-01, which is why it is its own step: enable 05-01, watch this stay green, and if it goes red the composer is letting the new clause jump the hierarchy.

steps.name: The page shows the comparison exactly as published
criteria: The opened reason is byte-identical to the published one and compares against the spot's own normal; nothing derived on the page.
steps.scenario_name: El surfista lee la comparación contra lo normal tal cual se publicó
steps.non_visual_rationale: Text fidelity over the built page; the measured-pixel judgement and the human charter belong to 05-06.
steps.implementation_notes: HARD SCHEDULING PRECONDITION, same as 02-05: per-row reasons render only after slice-01's four cross-lane diffs land (ConfidenceDetail.astro renders NOWHERE today; the wiring is step 01-11). Scheduled early it fails as setup: BROKEN, not RED; report and stop. RED TODAY through that same gap (recorded run). Expected green with no new production code once 01-11 lands, because the page renders whatever is published (slice-01's fidelity oracles); if it stays red after that, the defect is the mounts or the planted values, never a reason to weaken the byte-identity oracle. The planted wording is a placeholder pending Pre-requisites 1 and 7; the oracle pins only exact fidelity plus the noun 'normal'.

steps.name: The human sentence reads clean on the phone
criteria: The seven visual checks pass on the history-rich row against the real backdrop at 390 px, light-normal and dark-reduced both.
The longest climatology sentence wraps without clipping; nothing animates under reduced motion.
Gate runs captured by redirect then the exit code on its own line, never through a pipeline.
steps.scenario_name: La razón que compara contra lo normal se lee limpia en el teléfono, tema <tema>, movimiento <movimiento>
steps.u8_observation: La razón compara el día contra lo normal de ese spot y sigue sonando a una persona, no a un modelo.
steps.implementation_notes: THE ONLY USER-VISIBLE STEP OF THE SLICE. The U8 observation is settled verbatim in feature-delta.md's Slice classification table; use it word for word, and whoever owns docs/product/expectations/ writes the charter before COMMIT (filename may differ, U8 text may not). What the examiner is actually judging here is the one thing no assertion can: that the sentence sounds like a person who surfs this spot, not like a model talking about itself. The seven checks are the measured floor under that judgement, and they run as a standing regression net (they pass against the currently-mounted component; they must keep passing after the mount swap and after the new, potentially-longest wording lands). Same scheduling precondition as 05-05: BROKEN, not RED, before 01-11. Also honestly gated by Pre-requisites 1 and 7 through 05-01: there is no rendered climatology sentence to examine until the threshold is settled and the form switch ships.
